title: RAG / Retrieval Architecture Consultant for Multi-Agent AI System (Advisory Only)
description:
We are building a multi-agent AI system that needs to pull knowledge from a large database. We have hit a retrieval bottleneck: our agents can only hold and process a limited number of rows at a time, and they are not consistently getting the most relevant data for the task they are solving. The wrong rows reach the agents, or too many rows get passed in, and output quality suffers.

We are looking for an experienced AI/RAG engineer who understands retrieval design, context limits, and multi-agent orchestration. This is an advisory and guidance role. You do not need to build anything. We need you to review our setup, explain what is going wrong, and give us a clear, practical roadmap to fix it properly.

What we need from you:

1. Review our current data structure and agent workflow, and identify why the wrong or excessive data is reaching the agents.
2. Recommend the right retrieval architecture for our case, for example hybrid search (keyword + vector), metadata filtering, re-ranking, query rewriting or decomposition, chunking strategy, and per-agent retrieval scopes.
3. Explain how to fit the most relevant knowledge into each agent’s limited context, including top-k tuning, summarization or compression, and task-aware retrieval.
4. Deliver a clear step-by-step implementation guide (a call plus short written notes or a diagram) that our team can follow ourselves, including how to evaluate whether retrieval quality is improving.

This is a strict “Explain & Guide” mandate. No development is required.

Budget:
The budget listed on this post is only a starting price. Please apply with a budget that you consider reasonable for the scope of work described.

TO APPLY:
Please start your proposal with the word “RETRIEVAL”. Briefly answer these 3 questions:

1. How many years of experience do you have with RAG systems and LLM-based applications?
2. Have you designed retrieval for multi-agent systems (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom) or large databases before? Please share a brief example.
3. How would you approach diagnosing why agents are receiving irrelevant or too much data from a large database?
